raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On Intel XPU, `baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT` crashes during docvqa after a few dozen documents:

```
RuntimeError: level_zero backend failed with error: 40 (UR_RESULT_ERROR_OUT_OF_RESOURCES)
```

`Ernie4_5_VLMoeForConditionalGeneration.forward` calls `_set_visual_token_mask` on every forward, including every decode step. Each call allocates small device tensors (`_visual_token_ids_tensor_cache.to(device)`, `torch.as_tensor(pad_values, device=...)`, `torch.cat`, `torch.isin`). The level_zero backend does not reclaim them, so one prefill plus N decode steps per document adds up until device memory runs out.

The mask only decides which tokens go to the vision experts (`ernie45_moe_vl.py`). A `None` mask and an all-False mask take the same text-experts path, which is also the path CUDA-graph capture uses. Decode tokens are generated text, so the per-step mask is always all-False.

## Modifications

- In `python/sglang/srt/models/ernie45_vl.py`, build the mask only for non-decode batches that contain image inputs; otherwise set `visual_token_mask = None`.
- Image prefill/extend batches still build the mask, so vision routing is unchanged. Decode and text-only batches take the text-experts path, as before.
- No other model or platform code changes.

The same change is also part of #42627. If that merges first, this PR becomes a no-op and I will close it.

## Accuracy Tests

Intel Arc Pro B60, tp-size 4, `--attention-backend intel_xpu`, lmms_eval `docvqa_val`:

| Run | Docs | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Before, serialized (`num_concurrent=1`, `--max-running-requests 1`) | ~44 | crash, error 40 |
| After, same settings | 80/80 | 368,682 tokens, no error 40 |
| After, `num_concurrent=8`, `--mem-fraction-static 0.70`, no serialization flags | 150/150 | anls 0.9137, no error 40 |

The anls run sets `enable_thinking=false` in the chat template. ERNIE-4.5-VL opens a `<think>` block by default, and docvqa's short generation budget cuts it off before the answer.

Reproduce (serialized run):

```bash
SGLANG_USE_SGL_XPU=1 python3 -m sglang.launch_server --model-path baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT \
  --device xpu --tp-size 4 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --trust-remote-code --port 30000 \
  --context-length 8192 --disable-radix-cache --disable-overlap-schedule --max-running-requests 1 \
  --enable-multimodal --attention-backend intel_xpu

python3 -m lmms_eval --model openai_compatible \
  --model_args model_version=baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT,num_concurrent=1 \
  --tasks docvqa_val --batch_size 16 --limit 80
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No speed measurement. Each decode step now skips one `isin` and a few small allocations; image prefill is unchanged.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). Not added: the crash needs the full model on XPU, which the docvqa runs above cover.
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). Not needed.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

nodes.body: Closing this as it is getting merged as part of #42627.
Reopening so this fix can be reviewed on its own; the same change is also part of #42627. If that merges first, I'll close this one.

CUDA check on 1x NVIDIA H200 NVL (tp 1). Both runs use the same image (`lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-dev-20261015-a6a8c560`) with the sglang Python source taken from each commit:
- before: merge-base `6daae9c98e`
- after: this PR `69662a3a88`

| Task | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| docvqa_val, 1000 docs, anls | 0.9269 | 0.9270 |
| docvqa_val, all 5349 docs, anls | 0.9221 | 0.9224 |
| gsm8k, 1319 questions, strict / flexible | 0.7005 / 0.8514 | 0.7036 / 0.8560 |

No regression on CUDA. docvqa covers image prefill, which still builds the mask. gsm8k covers text-only batches, which now skip it.

```bash
sglang serve --model-path baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT --tp-size 1 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 \
  --trust-remote-code --context-length 8192 --enable-multimodal   # gsm8k: same, without --enable-multimodal

python3 -m lmms_eval --model openai --model_args model_version=baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT,num_concurrent=8 \
  --tasks docvqa_val --batch_size 8 --limit 1000 --seed 42 --gen_kwargs enable_thinking=false,max_new_tokens=64

lm_eval --model local-completions \
  --model_args pretrained=baidu/ERNIE-4.5-VL-28B-A3B-PT,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=16 \
  --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --batch_size 16 --seed 42 --gen_kwargs max_gen_toks=1024
```

detail.title: [Fix] ernie45_vl: Only build the visual-token mask for image prefill batches

files.patch:
@@ -709,7 +709,14 @@ def forward(
                     f"(3, seq_len) positions, but got {positions.size()}"
                 )
 
-        self._set_visual_token_mask(input_ids, forward_batch)
+        # Skip on decode/text-only batches: per-step mask allocs exhaust XPU memory.
+        if (
+            not forward_batch.forward_mode.is_decode()
+            and forward_batch.contains_image_inputs()
+        ):
+            self._set_visual_token_mask(input_ids, forward_batch)
+        else:
+            self.visual_token_mask = None
 
         assert input_ids.numel() == positions.shape[-1], (
             f"input_ids {input_ids.shape} and position_ids {positions.shape} should have the same length"
